needed.suggestion: Rebuild the right-hand pavement to a minimum 1.5 m clear width and install a physical barrier to keep the parked truck off the pedestrian route.

needed.suggestion: Enforce a no-storage zone on the left pavement and provide a designated off-street loading bay for the adjacent commercial units.
